idea: Duality hops (wildcard): hop 1 = a duality delta of H(3) (point->line bijection that maps the lines through a point onto the points of one line; found by distance-preserving backtracking in 0.6 s); hop 2 = random non-incident bijection; Z_M random flag and hop voltages.
